data.body:
[P2] Preserve application JSON that resembles an envelope

`invoke` defaults to `DEFAULT_JSON_SERDES`, and steps can explicitly use `JsonSerDes`, so `{"t":"m","v":{}}` is a valid application result. This unconditional default-serializer decode changes it to `{}` before the override receives it. Identity transforms publish incorrect data, while transforms accessing `t` or `v` fail and silently omit the result. Gate decoding on serializer provenance or provide a per-override decoding opt-out, with invoke and JsonSerDes collision regressions.
